name: Four Seasons Resort Seychelles
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort sits on one of the world's most pristine beaches where granite boulders meet powder-soft sand and crystal-clear waters.
whats_special: The resort is built around ancient granite formations that are over 750 million years old, making it one of the few hotels in the world constructed among such prehistoric geological wonders. Each villa is positioned to offer complete privacy while showcasing the dramatic contrast between lush tropical vegetation and sculptural granite boulders.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the hillside for sunrise views over the Indian Ocean, or choose beachfront for direct access to Petite Anse beach - consistently rated among the world's most beautiful beaches.
dont_miss: The resort's unique tree house spa treatments nestled 10 feet above the forest floor, and snorkeling right off the beach where you'll spot exotic fish species found nowhere else on Earth. The nearby Vallée de Mai Nature Reserve houses the legendary Coco de Mer palm, producing the world's largest seed.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beaches
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Luxurious villas with private pools and panoramic ocean views
World-class spa and wellness facilities in tropical setting
cons: Remote island location requires connecting flights
